profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Minnect
profile.summary:
I am a senior full-stack software engineer with over a decade of experience designing, building, and scaling production-ready web and mobile applications. My career has been defined by delivering high-quality, resilient, and performant software that balances speed of execution with long-term maintainability.

I thrive at the intersection of product vision and engineering execution, translating complex requirements into clean, reliable solutions that support business growth. My expertise spans front-end and back-end development, cloud infrastructure, and mobile platforms, allowing me to own features end-to-end and ensure seamless user experiences.

🔹 Known for shipping production-grade solutions quickly without compromising on quality.
🔹 Experienced in leading cross-functional initiatives, from conception and architecture through deployment and monitoring.
🔹 Focused on resiliency, scalability, and user impact—building systems that last.

I bring not just strong technical skills, but also a collaborative mindset and a focus on delivering measurable results that align with product and business goals.
